recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見數顆核偏心、染色質呈塊狀（clock-face）、細胞質呈灰藍至深藍色的細胞，部分核旁有淡染的高基氏區，左下大細胞細胞質豐富並含空泡；這些偏心核、嗜鹼性細胞質的特徵指向漿細胞，但本圖細胞重疊、典型度有限。
features: Several cells with eccentric round nuclei and moderately abundant grey-blue to deeply basophilic cytoplasm (upper right)
Coarse, clumped 'clock-face' chromatin in some nuclei; nucleoli inconspicuous
Large cell at lower left with eccentric nucleus and abundant cytoplasm containing clear vacuoles
Central cell with pale vacuolated cytoplasm overlapped by several nuclei, making cell boundaries difficult to assign
Background of other marrow precursors and a lymphocyte-sized cell with dense chromatin
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a group of cells including forms with eccentric round nuclei, coarse clumped chromatin, and grey-blue to basophilic cytoplasm consistent with plasma cells. A large cell at the lower left has abundant vacuolated cytoplasm with an eccentric nucleus, and a central cell with pale vacuolated cytoplasm is overlapped by several nuclei, which limits confident assignment of individual cells. A well-defined perinuclear hof is not clearly seen in every cell. Findings are consistent with plasma cells in a marrow aspirate; quantitation and light chain studies would be required to assess for a plasma cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts are larger with a pale hof located away from the nucleus and occur in loose clusters near bone, whereas plasma cells have a hof abutting the nucleus and smaller size.
Plasmacytoid lymphocytes are smaller with scant cytoplasm and are mixed with small lymphocytes and mast cells.
A macrophage has a single bland nucleus with phagocytosed material, while overlapping nuclei here belong to separate cells.
